title: The Bloodline
summary: Roman’s rise as Tribal Chief, Sami’s loyalty and betrayal, a divided family, and the struggle over who leads it. Selected chapters from 2020 through 2026.

chapters.title: Roman returns with a new attitude
chapters.result: Reigns attacked The Fiend and Braun Strowman.
chapters.context: The starting point for this timeline: the return that led to his Tribal Chief transformation. Earlier family alliances predate this saga.

chapters.title: The alliance with Paul Heyman
chapters.result: Heyman appeared alongside Roman Reigns.
chapters.context: A new adviser signaled a sharp change in Roman’s direction.

chapters.title: A championship reign begins
chapters.result: Roman Reigns defeated The Fiend and Braun Strowman.
chapters.context: Reigns entered late and pinned Strowman to become Universal Champion.

chapters.title: Jey challenges the head of the family
chapters.result: Roman Reigns retained against Jey Uso.
chapters.context: Jimmy’s intervention ended Roman’s brutal assault on his brother. Family authority became the central conflict.

chapters.title: Jey says “I quit”
chapters.result: Reigns defeated Jey in an I Quit match.
chapters.context: Roman’s attack on Jimmy forced Jey to surrender, consolidating the Tribal Chief’s control.

chapters.title: The Usos bring home tag gold
chapters.result: Jimmy and Jey defeated Rey and Dominik Mysterio.
chapters.context: The brothers added the SmackDown Tag Team Championship to the faction’s power.

chapters.title: Solo Sikoa arrives
chapters.result: Reigns retained against Drew McIntyre.
chapters.context: Solo pulled the referee out during a potential winning cover, giving Roman the opening to finish McIntyre.

chapters.title: Sami proves his loyalty
chapters.result: The Bloodline won the men’s WarGames match.
chapters.context: Zayn turned against longtime friend Kevin Owens inside the cage, helping his adopted faction win.

chapters.title: The chair shot that breaks the family
chapters.result: Sami Zayn struck Roman Reigns after Roman’s win over Owens.
chapters.context: Ordered to join the assault on his friend, Sami chose to turn on Roman. The Bloodline retaliated.

chapters.title: Owens and Zayn end the Usos’ reign
chapters.result: Kevin Owens and Sami Zayn won the undisputed tag titles.
chapters.context: The reunited friends defeated The Usos in the first-night main event.

chapters.title: Jimmy strikes Roman
chapters.result: Owens and Zayn retained against Reigns and Solo.
chapters.context: The Usos’ intervention escalated the family split and cost Roman and Solo their title challenge.

chapters.title: Bloodline Civil War
chapters.result: The Usos defeated Roman Reigns and Solo Sikoa.
chapters.context: Jimmy and Jey fought the leader they had once served, with Jey pinning Roman.

chapters.title: Jimmy betrays Jey
chapters.result: Roman retained against Jey in Tribal Combat.
chapters.context: Jimmy’s return and attack on his twin denied Jey the championship and leadership.

chapters.title: Cody finishes the story
chapters.result: Cody Rhodes defeated Roman Reigns.
chapters.context: The championship loss ended Roman’s dominant reign and preceded a struggle over the faction’s leadership.

chapters.title: Solo introduces Tama Tonga
chapters.result: Solo and Tama attacked Jimmy Uso.
chapters.context: With Roman absent, a different Bloodline began to take shape.

chapters.title: Jacob Fatu makes his entrance
chapters.result: Jacob attacked Cody Rhodes, Kevin Owens and Randy Orton.
chapters.context: Solo’s faction gained a destructive new ally after the main event ended by disqualification.

chapters.title: Roman returns against Solo
chapters.result: Cody Rhodes retained against Solo Sikoa.
chapters.context: Roman’s surprise return targeted Solo and reopened the battle for control of The Bloodline.

chapters.title: The original Bloodline reunites
chapters.result: Roman, The Usos, Sami Zayn and CM Punk won WarGames.
chapters.context: The reunited allies overcame Solo, Jacob, Tama, Tonga Loa and Bronson Reed.

chapters.title: Roman reclaims the Ula Fala
chapters.result: Roman Reigns defeated Solo Sikoa in Tribal Combat.
chapters.context: After both sides intervened, Roman prevailed and The Rock presented him with the Ula Fala.

chapters.title: Paul Heyman is rescued from the Bloodline by Jimmy Uso
chapters.result: Paul Heyman is rescued from the Bloodline by Jimmy Uso.

chapters.title: Cody Rhodes takes a Samoan Spike from the returning Solo Sikoa
chapters.result: Cody Rhodes takes a Samoan Spike from the returning Solo Sikoa.

chapters.title: Jimmy Uso helps Jacob Fatu resist an attack from Solo Sikoa and JC Mateo
chapters.result: Jimmy Uso helps Jacob Fatu resist an attack from Solo Sikoa and JC Mateo.

chapters.title: Solo Sikoa vs. Jacob Fatu
chapters.result: Solo Sikoa defeated Jacob Fatu via Pinfall to win the Title.

chapters.title: Roman Reigns & Jey Uso vs. Bron Breakker & Bronson Reed
chapters.result: Roman Reigns & Jey Uso defeated Bron Breakker & Bronson Reed via Pinfall.

chapters.title: Solo Sikoa vs. Jacob Fatu
chapters.result: Solo Sikoa defeated Jacob Fatu to retain the Title.

chapters.title: Roman Reigns vs. CM Punk
chapters.result: Roman Reigns defeats CM Punk (c) (33:56) - TITLE CHANGE !!!

chapters.title: Roman Reigns vs. Jacob Fatu
chapters.result: Roman Reigns (c) defeats Jacob Fatu (17:50)

chapters.title: Fatu attacks Reigns and both Usos during the acknowledgment ceremony
chapters.result: Fatu attacks Reigns and both Usos during the acknowledgment ceremony.

chapters.title: LA Knight, Royce Keys & Solo Sikoa vs. The Bloodline (Jacob Fatu, Jey Uso & Jimmy Uso)
chapters.result: LA Knight, Royce Keys & Solo Sikoa defeat The Bloodline (Jacob Fatu, Jey Uso & Jimmy Uso) (11:00)

chapters.title: The 946 abducts Sikoa
chapters.result: Royce Keys, Bronco Nima and Lucien Price abducted Solo Sikoa.

chapters.title: The Bloodline brawls with the 946; Jaida Parker hits Fatu with a car
chapters.result: The Bloodline brawls with the 946; Jaida Parker hits Fatu with a car.
